description: Create index.html landing page, update README with layout table, add .gitignore and MIT LICENSE file.
steps: 1. Create `index.html` - a landing/index page with dark theme matching the wallpaper aesthetic. List all 6 wallpaper layouts with: filename (as clickable link), description of what it shows, and suitable orientation (landscape/portrait/both). Use preview images from the README GitHub assets URLs. Link assets/style.css for consistent styling.

2. Update `README.md` - Add a markdown table documenting all 6 layouts: | Filename | Description | Orientation | with proper descriptions. Keep existing content (background section, links, images) but reorganize for clarity. Update any broken references due to file renames (add .html to Chinese filenames in any references).
4. Create `LICENSE` file with MIT license text, using current year and 'FengYun Dynamic Wallpaper Contributors' as copyright holder.
acceptance_criteria: index.html exists and links to all 6 wallpaper HTML files
README.md contains a table with all 6 layouts, descriptions, and orientations
LICENSE file exists with MIT license
verification: Verify index.html contains links to all 6 HTML wallpaper files
Verify README.md has a markdown table with 6 rows
Verify .gitignore and LICENSE files exist and have correct content
